name: Inkstand
summary: A black and white sales desk for a shop selling online, at markets, wholesale and on marketplaces
about: A complete sales and back-office app in strict black and white for a small paper goods brand. The Desk page is a live front page: a ticker of new sales, a headline that rewrites itself when the numbers move, and figures for every channel. It also has a working market-stall till, wholesale invoices for stockists, marketplace listings and payouts, products and an earnings report.
how: Read the Desk: new sales slide into the ticker every few seconds and the headline types itself again when the story changes.
Open Market till to ring up a stall sale: tap products, add a code such as MARKET10, then take cash with change, card or a mobile wallet.
Open Orders to pack, send, deliver or refund web shop and marketplace orders.
Create a wholesale invoice for a stockist, send it, and mark it paid; overdue ones get a red stamp.
Switch products on or off for each marketplace and press Sync stock now.
On Report, switch 7D, 30D or 12M to see each channel's earnings after fees, then print or download CSV.
